integrity: A finite exact enumerator covers the initial parameters; a separate back-and-forth proof covers every n,m >= 12. Code and reproducible output are supplied; no external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Rank four only in graph-only equality/adjacency language for KG(n,3), n>=6; no extension to other ranks or subset sizes. Historical priority remains a qualified risk; no independent scientific audit.
title: Seven exact four-round theories of three-subset Kneser graphs
